description: Ask Warehouse SAS for a key to {name}’s enterprise features: a 30-day trial, a free key for small organisations and schools, or a subscription.
eyebrow: For IT, security and purchasing teams
lede: A key unlocks {name}’s enterprise features at the addresses you name. Warehouse SAS signs each one by hand and sends it by email, and {name} checks it offline, never calling home.
form.title: Your request
sent: Received. Warehouse SAS signs your key and sends it to your work email.
again: It didn’t go through. Try again in an hour, or write to {contact}.
kinds: Every enterprise feature, free for 30 days.
For schools, non-profits and organisations of up to {small} people, for a year.
From {from} a year per organisation, never per seat. This page makes its quote as you fill it in.
origins.hint: Its address, or several separated by spaces: the key works only there. On localhost, {name} needs no key.
people: How many people will use it
name: Your name
billing.legend: For the quote and the invoice
quote.small: Up to {small} people, the key is free: choose Free key.
quote.large: Above {largest} people, or for a provider shared by several organisations, Warehouse SAS writes the quote: send the request.
